goal: Actual 31B adoption + independently graded correction from an existing official ADK runnable skill, before inventing host callbacks

hypotheses.H_feedback: V3R's official run_skill_script explicit test witness gives usable post-edit signal and rescues independent grader-resolved issues
hypotheses.H_reasoning: 31B does not invoke/consume skill or still makes semantically wrong edits; extra calls reduce correctness and no rescue

controls: Exact pinned 31B V2 model, sampling, same native tools, frozen 5min/28calls/80turns; treatment adds a legal Skill witness and its invocation policy only.

selection.method: Select the min SHA256(salt+'|'+ID) from each repo prefix, excluding all listed spent IDs, without reading issue text or reference patch. IDs are selected at private runtime from public tasks.

experiment.order: alternate task order 1 V2 then V3R, 2 V3R then V2, 3 V2 then V3R
experiment.primary: paired official swegemma grader-resolved tasks; rescue minus regression
secondary: test feedback consumed by model where observable
experiment.success: Any isolated net rescue is preliminary; independently corroborate elsewhere before official competition submission.
experiment.stop: No usable tool uptake or no net task-resolution rescue (or higher regressions) => retire V3R skill mechanism; don't prompt-tune on these IDs.

data_safety: Private Kaggle only: mount competition snapshots at runtime; no publication of raw tasks, traces, reference patches or model output; publish allowlisted aggregates only.
resource: One idempotent private 31B Kernel, no training, no competition submission, require >=6 GPU hours before starting, no equivalent live evaluation.
approval_scope: User requested continuation of experimental research; no new official submission authorized from this pilot.
